test_title: PYST 32: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following cities hosted the 2025 World Aquatics Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Singapore** has been officially selected to host the **2025 World Aquatics Championships**, making it the **first Southeast Asian nation** to host this prestigious global event.
 
• The announcement was made by **World Aquatics** (formerly known as **FINA**) in **February 2023**. The event is scheduled to take place from **July 11 to August 3, 2025**.
 
• The championships were originally awarded to **Kazan, Russia**, but the hosting rights were relocated due to the ongoing geopolitical situation and international sanctions. ***Hence, the mention of Singapore as the host is correct.***
 
• The **2025 World Aquatics Championships** will bring together the world's best athletes in six aquatic disciplines: **swimming**, **diving**, **high diving**, **open water swimming**, **artistic swimming**, and **water polo**.
 
• Over **2,500 athletes** representing approximately **200 national federations** are expected to participate in the event.
 
• Key competition venues in **Singapore** will include the **Singapore Sports Hub**, the **OCBC Aquatic Centre**, and **Sentosa** for open water and high diving events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Budapest (Option 1):**
 
 
• **Budapest, Hungary**, has been a frequent host of the championships, staging the event in **2017** and **2022**.
 
• It is also scheduled to host the **World Aquatics Championships** again in **2027**.
 
• The city is renowned for its **Danube Arena**, a world-class facility built specifically for aquatic sports.
 
 
 
• **Melbourne (Option 3):**
 
 
• **Melbourne, Australia**, hosted the **12th FINA World Championships** in **2007**.
 
• More recently, it hosted the **2022 FINA World Swimming Championships (25m)**, which is a short-course event.
 
• Australia is a powerhouse in swimming, often finishing near the top of the medal tally.
 
 
 
• **Doha (Option 4):**
 
 
• **Doha, Qatar**, hosted the **21st World Aquatics Championships** in **February 2024**.
 
• This was the first time the championships were held in the **Middle East**.
 
• The event served as a crucial qualifying stage for the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **World Aquatics:** In **December 2022**, the international federation formerly known as **FINA (Fédération Internationale de Natation)** rebranded itself as **World Aquatics** to better represent all aquatic disciplines.
 
• **Championship Cycle:** While the championships are traditionally held **biennially** (every two years in odd-numbered years), the schedule was disrupted by the **COVID-19 pandemic**, leading to consecutive championships in **2022 (Budapest)**, **2023 (Fukuoka)**, **2024 (Doha)**, and **2025 (Singapore)**.
 
• **Economic Impact:** Hosting the **World Aquatics Championships** is expected to provide a significant boost to **Singapore's tourism** and sports ecosystem, attracting fans and media from across the globe.
 
• **Future Hosts:** Following Singapore in **2025**, the championships will move to **Budapest** in **2027** and **Beijing, China**, in **2029**.
